text:
Mira: kicking off velocity POC for Prospect (requested window next week). Goal: sustained 150 qps generation with ~30s microbursts to 2k qps. Need runbook, cost estimate, and BYOK/KMS answers. @Priya can you own load plan? cc @Max for infra.
Priya: on it. quick q: avg prompt size + typical gen length? any embedding mix? do they want payloads redacted?
Mira: avg prompt ~300 tokens, gen ~200 tokens. embeddings ~5% of calls (small). Jorge asked for BYOK + TLS1.3 and redaction before sharing sample data.
Jorge: correct — we need BYOK and TLS. also curious about prewarm cost and whether Hosted can guarantee burst SLAs or if Dedicated is required.
Max: infra notes: to hit 2k spikes reliably we should prewarm caches and reserve burst capacity. ballpark hosted cost during bursts (13B quantized): ~$1.6k–$2k/hr transient. Dedicated sizing: ~8-10 GPUs to handle 2k bursts with safe headroom; monthly commit order-of-magnitude tens of thousands. I can refine after we pick exact model & quant.
Priya: proposed runbook (draft): 1) create test cluster 2) smoke at 50 qps 3) concurrency sweep (40 -> 200) 4) run standard sustained phase (150 qps, 20m) 5) run burst windows (30s, 60s) 6) collect p50/p95/p99, GPU util, and tail token counts. sample command: ```rwin loadtest --target 150 --spike 2000 --spike-duration 30 --model redwood-13b-q4_0 --concurrency 120``` ensure input data redacted.
Max: infra checklist: enable KMS alias `customer/byok/jorge` on test cluster; set hsm=true for Private option; set `--prewarm-duration 10m` to warm KV cache; add retry policy to client side for spike-start 5xx. Monitor metrics: serving.latency.*, cpu/gpu.util, and kvcache.hit_ratio.
deploy-bot: cluster created: cluster-id=vel-23-test, nodes=6 g4dn.xlarge, endpoint=vel-23.prod.redwood-internal:443
Priya: minimal smoke payload (redacted) for team to use: ```{"prompt":"Summarize invoice #REDACTED","max_tokens":200}``` add header `x-customer-id: vel-23` and `x-data-class: redacted`.
Mira: security ask: they want SOC2 attestation + custom questionnaire completed by Fri. who can take questionnaire?
Priya: I’ll take questionnaire ownership. Jorge — can you share the security contact and redacted dataset?
Jorge: I’ll send redacted samples and contact info by EOD. we can only send through SFTP with client-side encryption.
Max: quick smoke results from vel-23-test (first run): 50 qps stable -> p95 130ms p99 420ms. 150 qps sustained -> p95 230ms p99 980ms. 2k qps 30s spike -> observed tail latencies ~1.8s; a few 5xx at spike start before prewarm warmed caches. with prewarm + retry policy those 5xx disappear. attaching brief CSV with sample metrics.
Mira: useful. Priya — can you post finalized runbook + cost workbook by EOD Monday? Need SLA tradeoffs (Hosted vs Dedicated) in that sheet.
Priya: will do. uploading runbook + cost sheet to internal drive: https://rbx/internal/drive/vel-23-runbook (will replace with customer link once redacted). ping when ready :rocket:
Max: I’ll schedule prewarm and large-burst rehearsal Tue AM and add dashboards for p99, errors, and token burn. tagging @Eng-SRE to observe during rehearsal.
Eng-SRE: we’ll be on standby Tue AM. :eyes:
Jorge: pref demo Thu 10am PT if that works for Redwood team. can we confirm by Tue?
Mira: yes — locking Thursday demo 10am PT. Priya/Max, we’ll confirm by Tue after rehearsal. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
